root_cause_and_implementation: F-MD-B18-A002-013 documented five publication-mode defects in ReplayVerificationService::actualBoundInputContext(): temporal_identity_hash/calendar_status_hash always empty (read from nonexistent $publication/$run columns); reason_registry_hash a hash of two hardcoded constant arrays, never the real registry; coverage/eligibility/price-product versions not bound; only factor_set_hash stood for events (event revisions and verification states not bound); dataset boundary not bound. Reader (E043) made the publication's real, already-Binding-derived, already-Seal-verified identity available by explicit publication_id through buildManifestByPublicationId()'s bound_input_context and top-level compatibility-hash fields (identity_revision_set_hash, calendar_revision_set_hash, status_revision_set_hash, event_revision_set_hash, source_scale_assessment_set_hash, factor_decision_set_hash, factor_set_hash) and its VERIFIED/V1_LEGACY_NO_V2_BOUND_CONTEXT/BLOCKED classification. This evidence wires PUBLICATION_EXACT admission to consume that projection rather than recomputing: (1) replayAdmissibility() -- already the established 'may this result be believed at all, before asking whether it matched' gate for REPLAY_FIXTURE_SELF_GENERATED and REPLAY_CONFIG_UNBOUND -- gained one more clause: when a publication exists, fetch its bound_input_context via a new private boundInputContextProjection($publication) (itself just app(...)->buildManifestByPublicationId(...)->bound_input_context, read-only, no new query logic) and return a blocking reason unless status==='VERIFIED'. This is exactly the contract's 'V1 exact verification is BLOCKED unless complete authoritative bound evidence is already available and valid'. (2) actualBoundInputContext($run, $publication) now calls the same boundInputContextProjection() and, only when VERIFIED, fetches the full manifest once more to read identity_revision_set_hash (-> temporal_identity_hash directly), a canonical hash combining calendar_revision_set_hash+status_revision_set_hash (-> calendar_status_hash), and a canonical hash combining event_revision_set_hash+source_scale_assessment_set_hash+factor_decision_set_hash+factor_set_hash (-> event_factor_hash, now genuinely binding event revisions and verification/decision states, not only the factor-set digest). reason_registry_hash and formula_registry_hash are both sourced from the registry_versions (C10) component's already-verified payload_hash inside bound_input_context['components'] -- the one already-captured, already-verified component carrying both the real reason-registry snapshot and formula/build identity (confirmed by reading ProducerRegistrySnapshot::capture(), which computes reason_registry_hash from actual eod_reason_codes rows into that same payload). Splitting that one payload_hash into two independent sub-identities would require decoding the raw semantic_payload_json of the registry_versions capture, a new capability not built this turn; both fields intentionally share this one frozen, real, non-live source rather than the previous vacuous-constant/live-config values, and this simplification is stated here rather than hidden. read_model_version/serialization_version/executable_build_identity are left reading live config, unchanged -- F-013 did not name these three, and sourcing them from the frozen capture would need the same raw-payload decode; left as a documented, not silently closed, remaining gap. config_snapshot_hash/source_observation_manifest_hash/canonical_raw_input_hash are unchanged (not named defective by F-013, already sourced from the run's own immutable columns, not live/current state). Nothing here writes to md_publication_lineage_bindings, md_run_input_captures, or eod_publications -- both new/changed methods are pure reads through Reader's existing, unmodified read path. ReplayBackfillService, BackfillLifecycleOrchestrator, ReplaySmokeSuiteService and FullRangeCurrentEvidenceReplayService all call verifyRunAgainstFixture/verifyAsKnownAgainstFixture rather than duplicating comparison logic, so they inherit this gating structurally without being touched -- satisfying the contract's 'share a validator' requirement without a second implementation anywhere. AS_KNOWN mode (verifyAsKnownAgainstFixture, AsKnownReplaySnapshotService) was read in full and confirmed architecturally separate: publication_id is always null for this mode, it never touches md_publication_lineage_bindings, and F-013's bullets are all scoped 'in publication mode' -- AS_KNOWN was not named defective and is untouched. Its own known gap (an actual BLOCKED execution_state compared against a fixture that also expects BLOCKED can still report comparison_result=MATCH/replay_status=PASS rather than a distinct classification) is real but is explicitly marked '(C2 interface)' in the C1 contract's own Sec6 step 5 text -- deferred to a later contract phase, not this work unit, and not silently fixed here. Ten pre-existing tests across two files needed a buildManifestByPublicationId mock stub added (none previously mocked a method the production code never called): 7 in ReplayVerificationServiceTest.php, 1 standalone scenario plus the shared mocks() factory in B18ReplayComparisonExhaustivenessTest.php -- all stubbed to a genuinely VERIFIED (or, where the scenario is about CONFIG_UNBOUND, V1_LEGACY_NO_V2_BOUND_CONTEXT) projection, preserving each test's original intent exactly; none of their assertions were weakened or removed.
